no_oracle_leakage_confirmed.rule: all online variants use no offline/oracle evidence

shared_positions_used.rule: all variants use the same precomputed episode positions

permuted_control_mode_is_online_stepwise.rule: C variants learn online and permute at decision time

final_memory_permutation_used.rule: no variant uses final-memory post-hoc permutation

hard_exclusion_used.rule: hard_exclusion is always false for all variants

deceptive_family_preservation_valid.rule: all deceptive objects preserve expected family identity

any_scale_beats_A.rule: any signed_sum or signed_max_abs scale has PV < A_total_pv

any_scale_beats_permuted_median.rule: any scale has real PV < matching permuted median PV

any_scale_beats_family_only.rule: any scale has real PV < Family_only_online_control_total_pv

any_scale_reduces_online_offline_gap.rule: any scale has gap_to_offline smaller than scale=1.0

any_scale_macro_tradeoff_acceptable.rule: any scale has macro_delta_vs_A >= -0.01 and no hard_exclusion

best_scale_identified.rule: at least one scale improves PV vs scale=1.0 without macro_delta_vs_A < -0.02

best_scale_over_conservative.rule: best PV scale has macro_delta_vs_A < -0.02 or harmful > helpful

implementation_status.rule: pass if any scale beats A with acceptable macro tradeoff; partial otherwise
